title: WorldEvent
description: An event in the world, as published on NATS and written to Postgres `events` by the sink (spec section 7, Appendix D). Subject rule: each event is published on NATS subject geldar.<shard>.<type> (Appendix F). source_event_id is assigned at the producer and makes JetStream redelivery idempotent. Event types from spec section 7: thought, speech, action, damage, death, birth, trade, book_written, book_read, skill_defined, offering, proposal, vote, law, sleep, reflection, server_tps.

type.description: The event type, also the last NATS subject segment. One of the section 7 types listed above.

agent_id.description: The life the event concerns, when there is one.

thinker_id.description: The Thinker that produced the event, when there is one.

payload.description: Event-specific fields. Free-form, so this object does not set additionalProperties.
